acceptance: Reproduce both current failure shapes: wakeup guidance renders a full long TASK-ID anchor subject, and supervisor _anchor_commit_task_wip fallback can still exceed 72 characters for a long task ID.

Make one small deterministic subject-label rule shared or equivalently tested across worker wakeup guidance, worker anchor protocol, worker_commit preflight, and supervisor automatic anchor behavior. Every generated or worker-wrapper commit subject must be at most 72 characters while the full Task-ID remains in required trailers.

Add regression tests with a long task ID covering rendered wakeup text, automatic supervisor WIP anchor commit, and worker_commit rejecting an overlong message before staging or committing. Preserve valid short-task behavior.
Do not weaken the existing Commit trailers 72-character gate, add exemptions, change branch protection, alter merge classification, modify scheduler policy, or touch live runtime/state.

Record exact-head evidence. Every delivery commit subject must be at most 72 characters with required trailers. Deliver through a clean task branch, PR, independent exact-head review, required checks, and protected merge.
Published bad heads on PR #4743 and PR #4744 are outside this task; their owners must repair them through their existing governed task lifecycles after this guard is available.
